description: This file defines an abstract class `HonoUserAdapter` that provides default (mostly null or false) implementations of the `HonoUser` interface methods. It serves as a base class for user-related objects in the Hono framework, allowing subclasses to override specific behaviors.

classes.name: HonoUserAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing default implementations for the HonoUser interface, mainly returning null or default false values.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns null, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns null authorities, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Returns null token, can be overridden.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Returns true if current time is not before expiration time, indicating expiration.

methods.name: getExpirationTime
methods.description: Returns a fixed expiration time set to 10 minutes from now.
